name: Tây Ninh
registryAssessment: A first-party provincial land-environment portal publishes a 2030 land-use planning map specifically for Thành phố Tây Ninh and directs map/data requests to the provincial Văn phòng Đăng ký Đất đai (Land Registration Office), CSDL-TTLT office. This evidences a local land-map/registry custodian and procedure, but not an openly downloadable cadastral parcel-vector service.

queries.query: Tay Ninh Vietnam official cadastral parcel map land registry GIS
queries.result: Found the official Tây Ninh provincial land-environment portal's Thành phố Tây Ninh 2030 land-use planning map page. It identifies the provincial Land Registration Office as the contact for map access. No public parcel API or safe geometry response was found in first-party results.

queries.query: Tây Ninh bản đồ địa chính thửa đất cổng thông tin chính thức
queries.result: Found the official provincial portal page BẢN ĐỒ QUY HOẠCH SỬ DỤNG ĐẤT ĐẾN 2030 - THÀNH PHỐ TÂY NINH and official legal/procedural material. The map page says organizations and individuals needing the map should contact Văn phòng Đăng ký Đất đai tỉnh Tây Ninh, Phòng CSDL-TTLT. Search results did not expose a public parcel feature service.

officialSources.role: Tây Ninh provincial land-environment portal; Thành phố Tây Ninh 2030 land-use planning map
officialSources.observation: Indexed first-party page names the map and instructs users seeking map/data access to contact the provincial Văn phòng Đăng ký Đất đai, Phòng CSDL-TTLT, telephone 02766250758. This is land-use planning evidence, not proof of public cadastral parcel geometry.

officialSources.role: Tây Ninh provincial land-environment legal portal
officialSources.observation: Official portal lists current land and environmental legal/procedural material, including land registration and data-management context.

officialSources.role: Official legal text mirror for Tây Ninh land-data provision rules
officialSources.observation: Indexed official legal text describes online land-data lookup and distinguishes publicly available attributes from restricted owner, address, title, scanned-certificate and coordinate information. No unsafe fields were requested.

geometryDecision.reason: No safe anonymous full parcel polygon response was obtained. The first-party map page was discoverable through search but direct access from this environment failed at DNS resolution; no parcel endpoint, schema, CRS, stable native parcel ID, or geometry was verified. Exact-point non-hit must not be interpreted as citywide absence.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official Tây Ninh provincial land-use planning map for Thành phố Tây Ninh to 2030, with map access handled by the provincial Land Registration Office.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Local official map/registry custodian and access procedure verified from first-party indexed content; open cadastral parcel-vector availability, exact WUP-point inclusion, and complete city coverage were not verified.
